## Magic move example

::: {.magic-move-container data-lang="r"}

```r
Year.Release <- game$Year.Release
counts <- data.frame(table(Year.Release))
```

[]{.fragment .magic-move-step}

```r
Year.Release <- game$Year.Release
counts <- data.frame(
  table(Year.Release)
)
p <- game %>%
  select(Year.Release, Global.Sales)
```

[]{.fragment .magic-move-step}

```r
Year.Release <- game$Year.Release
counts <- data.frame(
  table(Year.Release)
)
p <- game %>%
  select(Year.Release, Global.Sales) %>%
  group_by(Year.Release) %>%
  summarise(Total.Sales = sum(Global.Sales))
```

:::

## If-else expansion

::: {.magic-move-container data-lang="javascript"}

```javascript
if (condition) a else if (condition2) b else c
```

[]{.fragment .magic-move-step}

```javascript
if (condition) {
  a
} else if (condition2) {
  b
} else {
  c
}
```

:::

## Function if-else expansion

::: {.magic-move-container data-lang="r"}

```r
fn <- function(x) {
  if (condition) stop("oh no")
  if (condition) return(1)
  if (condition) x <- 1
  x + 1
}
```

[]{.fragment .magic-move-step}

```r
fn <- function(x) {
  if (condition) {
    stop("oh no")
  }
  if (condition) {
    return(1)
  }
  if (condition) {
    x <- 1
  }
  x + 1
}
```

:::
